# Restaurant OS

> Run your restaurant like a tech company. All the digital menu and QR ordering features you need in one unified, commission-free platform.

Restaurant OS is a modern cloud operating system built specifically for restaurants, cafes, cloud kitchens, and boutique hospitality venues. It provides vector QR code table stands, real-time menu management, branded restaurant profiles, and lightning-fast digital menus that customers open instantly on any mobile browser without downloading an app.

## Core Capabilities

- Dynamic QR Stand Generation: Table-specific and counter vector QR stands (SVG & PNG) dynamically linked to the digital catalog.
- Real-Time Menu Builder: Instant category, dish, price, and out-of-stock item updating with zero reload latency.
- Commission-Free Model: 0% transaction commission on orders and menu interactions; restaurants keep 100% of revenue.
- Edge-Hosted Public Menus: Fast mobile catalog pages with progressive web caching and offline resiliency.
- Multi-Branch Architecture: Enterprise multi-location management under a single master dashboard.
